about: Killian Law Group, LLC is a personal injury firm with four offices across Maryland, including Baltimore, Owings Mills and Annapolis.
The firm states that the first consultation is free. It does not state a fee model on its public pages, so none is recorded here.

G1.evidence: Maryland does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.source: Published decisions of the Attorney Grievance Commission of Maryland, indexed by CourtListener (Free Law Project)
G2.evidence: No attorney this firm names appears as the respondent in any of the 2614 published discipline decisions of the Attorney Grievance Commission of Maryland, 1976 to 2026. Published decisions record what has been decided, so this covers a disbarment or suspension on the record and not whether a registration is current today.

G3.evidence: 4 physical locations verified on Google Business Profile. Maryland publishes no business register we can query. SDAT's entity search is a form rather than a dataset, its bulk data is sold rather than published, and the state's open data portal carries a count of businesses instead of the register. This is a limit of the published record and not something the firm can change.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 9 named attorneys published.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 1,827 public client reviews across 4 Google listings, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2014-11-18, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP
